To pull the sled, attach straps to the sled and hold them securely. Walk backward or forward while pulling, keeping your core tight and movements controlled.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slowly slide down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the ground, forming a 90-degree angle at your knees.
Ensure your knees are directly above your ankles and not extending past your toes.
Keep your back flat against the wall and hold this position for the desired amount of time.
To finish, slowly slide back up the wall to a standing position.

name: Burpee
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back to assume a plank position, keeping your body straight and core engaged.
Perform a push-up by lowering your chest to the ground and then pushing back up to the plank position.
Jump your feet forward to return to the squat position.
Explosively jump into the air, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately go into the next repetition.

name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended in front of you and legs straight.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by looking at the floor.
Simultaneously lift your arms and legs off the ground, engaging your core and glutes.
Hold the top position for a moment while squeezing your back muscles.
Slowly lower your arms and legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Pogo Jumps
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Engage your core and keep your chest up.
Begin by bouncing off the balls of your feet, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Use minimal knee flexion to propel yourself upward quickly.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately rebound into the next jump.
Maintain a steady rhythm and focus on quick, controlled movements.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions or time duration.

name: Pistol Box Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift one leg off the ground, extending it forward while keeping it straight.
Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
Slowly lower your body by bending the knee of the standing leg, pushing your hips back as if sitting down.
Descend until your glutes lightly touch the box or bench.
Pause briefly at the bottom position to maintain control.
Press through the heel of the standing leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
instructions: Begin by kneeling on a padded surface with your knees hip-width apart.
Keep your torso upright and engage your core muscles.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands on your hips for balance.
Slowly lean back while keeping your hips extended and maintaining a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Lower yourself until you feel a stretch in your quadriceps, ensuring that your back remains straight.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, then engage your quads to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Sumo Squat off Stepbox
instructions: Place two stepboxes on the floor a little wider than shoulder-width apart and make sure they are stable.
Stand with one foot on each stepbox, toes pointing slightly outward, and hold a kettlebell by the handle with both hands between your legs.
Keep your chest up, shoulders back, and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below, letting the kettlebell sink between the boxes.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a pair of dumbbells on the floor in front of you.
Bend at your hips and knees to lower your body and grasp the dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight, chest up, and shoulders back as you engage your core.
Drive through your heels to lift the dumbbells by extending your hips and knees to stand up straight.
At the top of the movement, ensure your body is fully upright with shoulders back and chest open.
Lower the dumbbells back to the ground by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, keeping the spine neutral.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standing Tibialis Raise
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, near a wall or sturdy object for support if needed.
Keep your knees slightly bent and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Lift your toes off the ground as high as possible while keeping your heels planted firmly on the floor.
Hold the top position for a moment, feeling the contraction in the front of your lower legs.
Slowly lower your toes back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms extended forward for balance.
Shift your weight onto one leg while lifting the opposite leg off the ground, keeping it straight in front of you.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body into a squat position on the standing leg, keeping the lifted leg extended.
Descend until your thigh is parallel to the ground or as low as your flexibility allows.
Push through the heel of the standing leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Place a platform or weight plate on the floor to create a deficit of 1-3 inches.
Stand on the platform with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Position the barbell over the middle of your feet and grip it with your hands just outside your knees.
Engage your core, retract your shoulder blades, and keep your back straight.
Take a deep breath, then push through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground.
Extend your hips and knees simultaneously until you are standing upright with the barbell in front of your thighs.
Lower the barbell back to the ground in a controlled manner by hinging at the hips and bending your knees.

name: Weighted Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the calf raise machine and adjust the knee pad to rest comfortably on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on the platform with your heels hanging off.
Select an appropriate weight and release the safety bar.
Lower your heels slowly until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Raise your heels by extending your ankles as high as possible.
Pause at the top of the movement for a moment to maximize contraction.
Lower your heels back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Step-up
instructions: Begin by setting up a stable bench at knee height.
Load a barbell with an appropriate weight and place it across your upper back, gripping it firmly with both hands.
Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart in front of the bench.
Step onto the bench with your right foot, pressing through the heel to lift your body upward.
Bring your left foot up to meet your right foot on the bench.
Step back down with your left foot first, followed by your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement starting with the left foot for equal repetitions on each side.

name: Treadmill Walk
instructions: Stand with your feet on the side rails, attach the safety clip to your clothing and start the belt at a slow speed.
Holding a handrail lightly, step onto the belt one foot at a time, then let go once your steps match the belt.
Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed and eyes looking forward.
Walk in the middle of the belt. Land on your heel just in front of your body and roll through the foot to push off from your toes.
Swing your arms naturally at your sides, opposite to your legs, without touching the handrails.
Raise the speed to a brisk walk you can hold for the planned time, keeping the belt flat.
To finish, lower the speed gradually, stop the belt and step off only once it has stopped completely.

name: Barbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Position a barbell on your upper back, resting it comfortably across your shoulders. Ensure your grip is slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing out at about a 30-degree angle.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body by bending at the hips and knees.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below while keeping your knees aligned with your toes.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control throughout the movement.

name: Smith Machine Glute Kickback
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at a height you can reach with the sole of your foot when kneeling on all fours beneath it.
Kneel on all fours under the bar with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Place the sole of one foot against the bar with the knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Engage your core and press the bar upward by extending your hip, keeping the knee bent.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring full hip extension without arching your back.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position, controlling the movement.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: 90 To 90 Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor and place your right leg in front of you with the knee bent 90 degrees, the shin across your body and the outside of the leg on the floor.
Place your left leg out to the side with the knee bent 90 degrees, the thigh pointing sideways and the shin pointing back.
Rest your hands on the floor beside your front shin.
Sit up tall: lift your chest, keep your back straight and let both hips sink as close to the floor as you can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly. You should feel the stretch in the glute and outer hip of the front leg.
Come out of the position and set it up on the other side, left leg in front and right leg to the side.
Hold the second side for the same time.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your left leg, keeping a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips, extending your right leg straight behind you while lowering the barbell along your standing leg towards the ground.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement.
Lower until your torso is parallel to the floor or as far as your flexibility allows.
Return to the starting position by driving through your left heel and bringing your right leg forward.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Half Kneeling Quad Stretch
instructions: Begin in a half-kneeling position with your right knee on the ground and your left foot flat in front of you, forming a 90-degree angle at both knees.
Keep your torso upright and engage your core muscles to maintain balance.
Reach back with your right hand and gently grasp your right ankle or foot.
Slowly pull your right foot towards your glutes, feeling a stretch in the front of your right thigh.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, ensuring you maintain steady breathing.
Release the stretch and switch sides to repeat with the left leg.

name: Hang Power Clean
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your thighs.
Bend slightly at the hips and knees, lowering the barbell to just above your knees. This is your starting position.
Explosively extend your hips and knees while pulling the barbell upward, keeping it close to your body.
As the bar reaches chest height, rotate your elbows under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat position.
Stand up straight to complete the movement, then lower the barbell back to the starting position for the next repetition.

name: Smith Split Squat
instructions: Set the bar on the Smith machine to a height just below shoulder level.
Stand with your back to the bar and position one foot forward and the other foot back, similar to a lunge stance.
Place the bar across your upper back and shoulders, ensuring it is secure and comfortable.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your back knee towards the ground by bending both knees.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor, ensuring your front knee does not extend past your toes.
Press through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Snatch Pull
instructions: Start by standing with your feet hip-width apart, with the barbell over your mid-foot.
Bend at the hips and knees to grip the barbell with a wide, overhand grip.
Set your back by retracting your shoulder blades and engaging your core.
Initiate the lift by extending your knees and hips simultaneously, keeping the bar close to your body.
As the bar passes your knees, explosively extend your hips and knees while shrugging your shoulders upward.
Keep your arms straight until you reach full extension, then allow a slight bend as you pull the bar to chest height.
Control the bar back to the starting position for the next repetition.

name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell or kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest.
Shift your weight to your right leg, bending your right knee and lowering your hips into a squat position while keeping your left leg straight.
Ensure your right foot remains flat on the ground and your knee is aligned with your toes.
Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement on the left side by shifting your weight to your left leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Band Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at floor level.
Lie face down on a mat, with your legs extended and feet close to the anchor point.
Secure the other end of the band around your ankles.
Keep your core engaged and hips pressed into the ground.
Flex your knees, pulling your heels towards your glutes against the band's resistance.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring maximum contraction in the hamstrings.
Slowly extend your legs back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell or kettlebell with both hands at chest level.
Keep your elbows close to your body and ensure the weight is secure.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body by bending at the hips and knees.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as low as your flexibility allows.
Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Side Lunges
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or clasped in front of your chest.
Take a large step to the right, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
Lower your hips down and back as if sitting into a chair, ensuring your right knee does not extend past your toes.
Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
Push off with your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the left side.

name: Kettlebell Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder height or with both hands in front of your chest.
Engage your core and keep your chest up.
Step back with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees. The front knee should be directly above the ankle.
Ensure the back knee hovers just above the ground without touching it.
Push through the heel of the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Dumbbell Side Lunges
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at your chest with both hands.
Step out to the right side with your right foot, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
Lower your hips back and down as you lunge, ensuring your right knee does not extend past your toes.
Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the movement.
Push through your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the left side, stepping out with your left foot.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes slightly pointed out.
Shift your weight onto your right leg, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
Lower your hips down towards the right heel, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Ensure your right knee tracks over your right foot and does not extend past your toes.
Keep your left foot flat on the ground or allow the toes to point upwards as you descend.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the left side by shifting your weight onto your left leg.

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointed slightly outward.
Keep your chest up, shoulders back, and core engaged throughout the movement.
Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not extend past them.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below, depending on flexibility.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.

name: Glute-Ham Raise 1/2
instructions: Begin by securing your feet under the footplate of a glute-ham developer (GHD) machine, with your knees resting on the pad.
Ensure your body is straight from head to knees, with your hands crossed over your chest or placed behind your head.
Engage your core and glutes as you slowly lower your torso forward by extending at the knees, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body until it is parallel to the ground or slightly below, maintaining tension in the hamstrings.
Pause briefly at the bottom position to maximize muscle engagement.
Initiate the upward movement by contracting your hamstrings and glutes, pulling your body back up to the upright kneeling position.
Pause briefly at the top before starting the next lowering phase.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place a kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge at the hips by pushing them back while keeping your back straight and chest up.
Grip the kettlebell handle with both hands, ensuring your shoulders are above or slightly in front of the kettlebell.
Engage your core and drive through your heels to lift the kettlebell, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Stand fully upright with the kettlebell in front of your thighs, keeping your shoulders back and chest proud.
Reverse the movement by hinging at the hips and lowering the kettlebell back to the ground with control.

name: Landmine Squat
instructions: Position the barbell in the landmine attachment, ensuring it is securely anchored.
Stand facing the barbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the end of the barbell with both hands, holding it close to your chest.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as your mobility allows.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single-Leg Cable Leg Curl
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to the low pulley of a cable machine.
Secure the strap around your ankle and stand facing the machine.
Step back to create tension in the cable, standing on your non-working leg for stability.
Keep your torso upright and hold onto the machine for support if necessary.
Flex your working knee to curl your heel towards your glutes, keeping your thigh stationary.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring maximum contraction in the hamstrings.
Slowly extend your leg back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Smith Kneeling Hip Thrust
instructions: Position a bench or padded surface behind the Smith machine bar at knee height.
Kneel on the floor with your back facing the bench, and position your shoulders against it.
Place the Smith machine bar across your hips, ensuring it is securely locked in place.
Grip the bar with both hands for stability.
Engage your core and glutes, then thrust your hips upward until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your glutes tightly.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position without resting them on the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or holding weights at your sides.
Step back with your right foot, landing on the ball of your foot and keeping your heel off the ground.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees. Your front knee should be directly above your ankle, and your back knee should hover just above the floor.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the left leg stepping back. Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Broad Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back into a quarter squat position.
Swing your arms backward to generate momentum.
Explosively jump forward as far as you can, swinging your arms forward and extending your legs.
Land softly on your whole feet with your hips back and knees bent to absorb the impact.
Reset your position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Clean Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and position a barbell over your mid-foot.
Bend at the hips and knees to grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your chest up, back straight, and engage your core.
Initiate the lift by extending your hips and knees explosively to pull the barbell off the ground.
As the bar reaches your thighs, shrug your shoulders and pull yourself under the bar into a front squat position.
Catch the bar on your shoulders with elbows high and upper arms parallel to the ground.
Lower into a deep squat by bending at the hips and knees while keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, maintaining control of the barbell on your shoulders.
Lower the barbell back to the ground with control to complete one repetition.

name: Lizard Pose
instructions: Begin in a downward-facing dog position with your hands and feet on the mat.
Step your right foot forward to the outside of your right hand, aligning your knee over your ankle.
Lower your left knee to the mat and slide it back slightly to extend your leg.
Keep your hands on the mat or lower onto your forearms for a deeper stretch.
Hold the pose for several breaths, keeping your gaze forward or down.
To release, press back into downward-facing dog and repeat on the other side.

name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back straight and legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to drop to the sides.
Hold your feet with your hands and pull them gently towards your body.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from the hips to deepen the stretch.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds while breathing deeply.
Release and return to the starting position.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump into the air.
As you jump, spread your legs shoulder-width apart and raise your arms above your head.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent to absorb impact.
Quickly jump back to the starting position by bringing your feet together and lowering your arms to your sides.
Repeat the movement continuously at a steady pace.

name: Barbell Cossack Squat
instructions: Set a barbell in a squat rack at upper-chest height and load it lightly. Step under the bar, place it securely across your upper traps or rear shoulders, grip the bar firmly, brace your core, and walk back carefully into a wide stance with your toes turned slightly outward.
Stand tall with your feet wider than shoulder width, keep your chest lifted, and distribute your weight evenly through both feet before starting the movement.

Shift your body weight toward one leg while bending that knee and pushing your hips back and down. Keep the working foot flat on the floor and allow the knee to track in the same direction as the toes.

As you descend, keep the opposite leg straight and extend it out to the side. Keep the heel of the straight leg on the floor if your mobility allows; otherwise, allow the toes to point upward while maintaining control.
Lower only as far as you can while keeping your spine neutral, chest proud, and the barbell stable over your mid-foot. Avoid rounding your lower back or letting the working knee collapse inward.
Press firmly through the heel and mid-foot of the bent leg to return to the starting wide stance, keeping your core braced and the bar level throughout the ascent.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions. Re-rack the barbell carefully when finished.

name: Sumo Squat With Smith
instructions: Position the bar of the Smith machine at shoulder height and set the safety stops just below your lowest squat position.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes slightly pointed outwards.
Place the bar across your upper back, ensuring it rests comfortably on your trapezius muscles.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar by straightening your legs and stepping back slightly.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower into a squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.

name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Start with your feet shoulder-width apart, barbell over mid-foot.
Grip the barbell with a hook grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your hips with a straight back and chest up.
Initiate the lift by extending your knees and hips explosively.
Pull the bar close to your body, shrugging your shoulders as it passes your knees.
Drop under the bar into a front squat position as you catch it on your shoulders.
Stand up from the squat to complete the Clean phase.
For the Jerk, dip slightly by bending your knees and then drive upward explosively.
Push the bar overhead while splitting your legs into a lunge position.
Lock out your arms with the barbell overhead and stabilize.
Bring your feet together to finish in a standing position with control.

name: Single-Leg Seated Calf Raise with Dumbbell
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place a dumbbell on top of your right knee, holding it securely with your hand.
Position the ball of your right foot on an elevated surface, such as a step or block, allowing your heel to hang off.
Keep your left foot flat on the floor for stability.
Slowly raise your right heel as high as possible by contracting your calf muscle.
Pause at the top of the movement for a moment to maximize contraction.
Lower your heel back down below the level of the step to stretch the calf muscle.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the left leg.

name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Set the cable machine to the lowest setting and attach a straight bar or rope handle.
Stand facing the cable machine with feet hip-width apart and grasp the handle with both hands using an overhand grip.
Step back slightly to create tension in the cable, keeping your arms straight and shoulders back.
Engage your core and maintain a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back while keeping your back straight and chest up.
Lower the handle towards your shins until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, then drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

name: Lunges
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or holding weights at your sides.
Step forward with your right foot, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about a 90-degree angle.
Ensure your front knee is directly above your ankle and your back knee hovers just above the ground.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg to complete one full repetition.

name: Single Leg Smith Calf Raise
instructions: Position yourself under the Smith machine bar with the bar resting on your shoulders.
Place one foot on a raised platform or step, ensuring your heel is hanging off the edge.
Unlock the Smith machine bar by rotating it forward.
Lower your heel towards the ground in a controlled manner to stretch the calf muscle.
Press through the ball of your foot to raise your heel as high as possible, contracting your calf muscle.
Hold the top position briefly before lowering back down.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other leg.

name: Band Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, with the resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as comfortable while maintaining tension in the band.
Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Sliding Leg Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on a smooth surface.
Place your arms at your sides with palms facing down for stability.
Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from shoulders to knees, engaging your core and glutes.
Slowly slide your feet away from your body, extending your legs while keeping hips elevated.
Pause briefly when legs are fully extended, then slide feet back towards your body to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining control and form.

name: Seated Single Leg Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place the sole of your right foot against the inner thigh of your left leg.
Keep your left leg straight and toes pointing towards the ceiling.
Inhale deeply, then slowly exhale as you lean forward from your hips, reaching towards your left foot with both hands.
Maintain a straight back and avoid rounding your shoulders as you stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull along the back of your left thigh.
Slowly return to the starting position and switch legs to repeat on the other side.

name: Half Squat
instructions: Set a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out.
Engage your core and keep your chest up.
Begin the movement by pushing your hips back as if sitting in a chair.
Lower your body about halfway, stopping with your thighs well above parallel to the floor.
Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not extend past them.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standing Forward Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Inhale deeply, then exhale as you hinge at your hips to fold forward.
Keep your knees slightly bent if necessary to avoid straining your lower back.
Allow your head to hang heavy and relax your neck.
Place your hands on the floor, on blocks, or hold onto opposite elbows.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
To come up, engage your core and slowly roll up vertebra by vertebra.

name: Deep Squat to Wide Fold with Foot Hold
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Lower into a deep squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and spine neutral.
Once in the squat position, extend your arms forward for balance.
From the squat, lean forward and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Shift your weight onto your hands and straighten your legs into a wide forward fold.
Reach for your feet or ankles, holding onto them to deepen the stretch.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and return to the deep squat position.
Repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Swings
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart next to a wall or sturdy object for support.
Place your left hand on the wall for balance.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right leg slightly off the ground.
Swing your right leg forward and backward in a controlled manner, keeping your torso upright.
Perform 10-15 swings, then switch legs and repeat the movement with your left leg.
Maintain a steady pace and avoid jerky movements to prevent injury.

name: Resistance Band Hip Adduction
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at ankle height.
Stand sideways to the anchor point and loop the free end of the band around your inside ankle.
Step away from the anchor point until there is tension in the band.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
Shift your weight onto the leg farthest from the anchor point.
Slowly bring the banded leg across your body towards the standing leg, keeping it straight.
Pause briefly at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Terminal Knee Extension
instructions: Anchor a resistance band at knee height and loop it around the back of your knee.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet hip-width apart, so the band pulls the back of your knee forward.
Start with your knee slightly bent, keeping your foot flat on the ground.
Engage your quadriceps to extend your knee fully, straightening your leg against the resistance of the band.
Hold the fully extended position for a moment, ensuring full contraction of the quadriceps.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, maintaining tension in the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Downward Dog
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Spread your fingers wide and press firmly into the ground with your palms.
Tuck your toes under and lift your knees off the floor, raising your hips towards the ceiling.
Straighten your legs as much as possible without locking your knees, forming an inverted V shape with your body.
Keep your head between your arms, ears aligned with upper arms, and gaze towards your feet or navel.
Hold the position for several breaths, maintaining a steady and deep breathing pattern.
To release, lower your knees back to the floor and return to the starting position.

name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand between your legs.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to lower the kettlebell back between your legs.
Drive through your heels and thrust your hips forward to swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height.
Keep your arm straight but not locked out, allowing the momentum to carry the kettlebell.
Control the descent by hinging at the hips again as the kettlebell swings back down.
Repeat for desired repetitions before switching arms.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and position a loaded barbell behind your legs.
Bend at the knees and hips to lower your body, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and drive through your heels to lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees.
Keep the bar close to your body as you stand up fully, maintaining an upright torso.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position in a controlled manner by bending your knees and hips.

name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip. Your elbows should be pointing forward and slightly up.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower into a squat, pushing your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Drive through your heels to stand up explosively, using the momentum to press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height in a controlled manner to complete one repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining proper form throughout.

name: Barbell Split Squat
instructions: Begin by placing a barbell across your upper back, gripping it slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and step one foot forward into a staggered stance.
Lower your hips by bending both knees until the back knee nearly touches the ground.
Ensure the front knee is aligned over the ankle and does not extend past the toes.
Push through the heel of the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your knees slightly bent and maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
Hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbells towards the floor, keeping them close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, ensuring your back remains straight.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position by thrusting your hips forward.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hip Circles
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands on your hips.
Engage your core muscles to maintain balance and stability.
Begin by slowly rotating your hips in a clockwise direction, making large circles.
Complete 10-15 rotations, then switch to a counterclockwise direction for another 10-15 rotations.
Keep your upper body stable and focus on moving only your hips.

name: Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a kettlebell between your feet.
Bend at the hips and knees to grip the kettlebell handle with one hand, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Engage your core and drive through your heels to lift the kettlebell off the ground.
As the kettlebell rises, pull it close to your body by bending your elbow and rotating your wrist.
Quickly tuck your elbow into your side and allow the kettlebell to rotate around your forearm into the rack position.
Stand tall with the kettlebell resting on the outside of your forearm, elbow close to your body.
Reverse the motion to lower the kettlebell back to the starting position.

name: Forward Band Monster Walk
instructions: Place a resistance band around your ankles.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Engage your core and keep your chest up.
Step forward with your right foot, maintaining tension in the band.
Follow with your left foot, keeping the band taut throughout.
Continue walking forward for the desired number of steps or distance.
Maintain a controlled pace and avoid letting your knees collapse inward.

name: Smith Squat To Bench
instructions: Position a bench behind you in the Smith machine so that when you sit back, your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Adjust the bar on the Smith machine to shoulder height. Load the desired weight onto the bar.
Stand under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. Position the bar across your upper back and shoulders.
Unrack the bar by rotating it forward. Step back until your legs are aligned with the bench.
Engage your core, keep your chest up, and begin lowering your body by bending at the hips and knees.
Descend until your glutes lightly touch the bench, ensuring your knees do not extend past your toes.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand upright next to a sturdy support, such as a squat rack or parallel bars, with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold onto the support with one hand for balance.
Lift one leg off the ground, extending it straight in front of you.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body into a squat on the supporting leg, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Descend as low as you can comfortably go while maintaining control and balance.
Push through the heel of your supporting foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Bulgarian Jump Squat
instructions: Begin by standing a few feet in front of a bench or elevated surface. Extend one leg back and place the top of your foot on the bench.
Lower your hips into a squat position by bending your front knee, ensuring it aligns over your ankle. Your back knee should drop towards the ground.
Explode upwards by pushing through your front heel, jumping as high as possible while keeping your back foot on the bench.
Land softly on your front foot, immediately lowering back into the squat position to prepare for the next repetition.
Complete the desired number of repetitions on one leg before switching to the other.

name: Smith Front Squat
instructions: Set the bar on the Smith machine at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and position yourself under the bar.
Cross your arms over your chest and rest the bar across your front deltoids.
Unrack the bar by rotating it forward and step back slightly.
Keep your chest up, core engaged, and back straight.
Lower your body by bending at the knees and hips until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hack Squat Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Set the hack squat machine to a light starting load and adjust the shoulder pads so you can stand securely with your shoulders under them.
Place the balls of both feet on the lower edge of the foot platform, about hip-width apart. Let your heels extend off the platform so they can move freely.
Stand tall with your back supported against the pad, brace your abdomen, and keep your knees straight but not locked.
Release the machine safety handles, then lower your heels slowly toward the floor until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet and raise your heels as high as possible, squeezing your calves at the top.
Pause briefly at the top without bending your knees or pushing with your thighs.
Lower your heels under control and repeat for the planned number of repetitions. Re-engage the safety handles before stepping out of the machine.

name: Single-Leg Box Jump
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box or platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto one leg, bending the knee slightly to prepare for the jump.
Swing your arms back to generate momentum.
Explosively jump onto the box using the power from your standing leg, swinging your arms forward for additional lift.
Land softly on the box with the same leg, ensuring your knee is slightly bent to absorb impact.
Step down carefully with the opposite leg and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Kneeling Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Begin by kneeling on the floor with your knees hip-width apart.
Extend your right leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground and toes pointing upwards.
Shift your hips back slightly while keeping your spine straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward gently from the hips until you feel a stretch along the back of your extended leg.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and maintaining a relaxed posture.
Return to the starting position and switch legs to repeat on the other side.

name: Barbell Overhead Squat
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out.
Grip the barbell with a wide overhand grip and press it overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Engage your core and ensure your elbows are locked out with the barbell directly above your head.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Lower yourself until your thighs are at least parallel to the ground, maintaining the barbell's position overhead.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, ensuring the barbell remains stable overhead throughout the movement.

name: Rocking Half Frog Stretch
instructions: Begin on all fours in a tabletop position with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend one leg straight back while keeping the other knee bent at a 90-degree angle, foot turned out to the side.
Slowly rock your hips back towards your heels, feeling a stretch in the inner thigh of the bent leg.
Hold the stretch for a moment, then rock forward to return to the starting position.
Repeat the rocking motion for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Pin Squat
instructions: Set the safety pins in a power rack at the desired height, typically at or just below parallel to your squat depth.
Position the barbell on the pins and load it with an appropriate weight.
Stand under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and position it across your upper back, ensuring it is centered.
Grip the bar firmly with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core, retract your shoulder blades, and maintain a neutral spine.
Lift the bar off the pins by driving through your heels and extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the bar back to the pins by bending your hips and knees, maintaining control throughout.
Ensure that each rep starts from a dead stop on the pins to maximize effectiveness.

name: Knee To Chest Stretch
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and arms at your sides.
Bend your right knee and gently pull it towards your chest using both hands.
Keep your left leg extended on the floor, ensuring your lower back remains in contact with the mat.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds while breathing deeply.
Release the right knee and return to the starting position.
Repeat the stretch with your left knee.

name: Lying Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs straight in front of you.
Bend one knee and fold that leg back so the foot rests beside your hip, top of the foot on the floor.
Lean back slowly and lower yourself onto your forearms behind you.
Keep the bent knee on the floor and your hips level until you feel a stretch along the front of the thigh.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, maintaining steady breathing.
Push up on your hands to sit up, straighten the leg and repeat on the other side.

name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your left leg.
Bend your right knee and bring your right heel towards your buttocks.
Reach back with your right hand and grasp your right ankle or foot.
Keep your knees close together and stand tall, avoiding any forward lean.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull in the front of your thigh.
Release the stretch and repeat on the opposite leg.

name: Glute Bridge Walkout
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, and arms by your sides with palms on the floor.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Take a small step forward with one heel, then with the other.
Keep walking your feet out in short alternating steps until your legs are almost straight, with your hips still off the floor.
Walk your feet back toward your glutes with the same short steps, driving your hips up as your knees bend.
Finish at the top of the bridge and start the next repetition from there.

name: Dumbbell Jump
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you bend your knees and lower into a squat position.
Explosively push through your heels to jump upwards as high as possible.
As you jump, keep the dumbbells at your sides without swinging them.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, immediately bending your knees to absorb the impact and return to the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Kickboxing
instructions: Begin with a proper warm-up to prepare your muscles and joints. This can include dynamic stretches and light cardio exercises.
Stand in a fighting stance with your feet shoulder-width apart, one foot slightly forward, and knees slightly bent.
Keep your hands up near your face to protect yourself, elbows close to your body.
Practice basic punches such as jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Focus on form and control.
Incorporate kicks like front kicks, roundhouse kicks, and side kicks. Ensure proper balance and technique.
Combine punches and kicks into combinations to enhance coordination and fluidity.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern; exhale with each punch or kick for power.
Cool down after your session with static stretches to improve flexibility and reduce muscle soreness.

name: Plyo side lunge
instructions: Start by standing with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Engage your core and take a large step to the right, bending your right knee and pushing your hips back into a side lunge position. Keep your left leg straight.
As you lower into the lunge, ensure your right knee is aligned with your right foot and does not extend past your toes.
Push off explosively with your right foot to jump back to the starting position.
Immediately step out to the left side and repeat the movement on the opposite leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Smith Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Position a bench or a calf raise block under the Smith machine bar.
Sit on the bench with your feet flat on the block, ensuring your knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
Position the Smith machine bar across your thighs, just above your knees.
Unlock the Smith machine bar by rotating it forward.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible, contracting your calves.
Pause at the top of the movement for a moment to maximize contraction.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rocking Frog
instructions: Begin by kneeling on the floor with your knees spread wide apart and your feet together behind you.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you, keeping your arms straight.
Lower your hips back towards your heels while keeping your back straight and chest open.
Rock forward gently, bringing your chest closer to the floor while maintaining a straight back.
Continue to rock back and forth slowly, feeling the stretch in your hips and groin.
Perform for the desired number of repetitions or time duration.

name: Smith Zercher Squat
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar to about waist height.
Stand close to the bar and position it in the crook of your elbows, with your arms bent and hands clasped together.
Step back slightly so that your feet are shoulder-width apart and toes are slightly pointed out.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower into a squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as far as your mobility allows.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping your back straight and core engaged throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Vertical Leg Press Smith Machine
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar low enough to reach with your feet, then lie on your back on the floor with your hips under the bar.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the bar.
Unlock the Smith Machine bar by rotating it slightly to release it from its locked position.
Lower the bar slowly towards your chest by bending your knees, keeping your feet flat on the bar.
Press the bar back up by extending your legs fully without locking your knees at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then carefully lock the bar back into place.

name: Weighted Pistol Squat
instructions: Begin by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest.
Extend one leg forward, keeping it straight and off the ground.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body into a squat on the supporting leg, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Descend until your thigh is parallel to the ground or as low as your flexibility allows.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, then press through your heel to return to the starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions on one leg before switching to the other.

name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Load plates onto the machine's lever and step onto the foot platform with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Lean back against the pad, set your shoulders under the shoulder pads and grip the handles on top of them.
Straighten your legs to take the weight and release the safety lever if your machine has one.
Brace your core and bend your knees and hips to lower yourself as the pad swings down along its arc.
Go as deep as you can while your heels stay flat and your lower back stays on the pad.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up, stopping just before your knees lock.
After the last rep, engage the safety lever if there is one and step off the platform.

name: Bench Front Squat
instructions: Position a bench behind you at a height that allows your thighs to be parallel to the ground when seated.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out, and place a barbell across the front of your shoulders, securing it with your hands.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body by bending at the hips and knees.
Descend until your glutes lightly touch the bench, ensuring your knees track over your toes.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
Maintain an upright torso throughout the movement and avoid leaning forward.

name: Seated Forward Fold
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Flex your feet so that your toes point upwards and your heels press into the ground.
Inhale deeply, lengthening your spine upwards.
As you exhale, hinge at the hips to lean forward, keeping your back straight.
Reach towards your feet with your hands, aiming to hold your feet or ankles. If this is difficult, place your hands on your shins or use a strap around your feet.
Maintain a relaxed neck and gaze softly towards your legs.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds while breathing deeply.
To release, inhale and gently lift your torso back to an upright position.

name: Cable Terminal Knee Extension
instructions: Attach an ankle strap or a short loop to the pulley of a cable machine and set it at about knee height.
Face the machine and place the strap around the back of your working leg, just below the knee.
Step back until the cable is taut and hold the frame with both hands for balance.
Let the cable pull your knee forward into a slight bend, with the heel lifting and your weight on the ball of the foot.
Straighten your knee by pushing it back against the cable until the leg is straight and the heel is back on the floor.
Squeeze your quadriceps for a moment at full extension.
Slowly let the knee bend forward again under control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.

name: Butterfly Lean Forward Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back straight and legs bent at the knees.
Bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to drop outward.
Hold your feet with your hands and pull them gently towards your body.
Inhale deeply, then exhale as you lean forward from the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lean forward as far as comfortable, feeling a stretch in the inner thighs and hips.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds while breathing deeply.
Slowly return to the starting position.

name: Reverse Plank
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your feet together.
Place your hands on the floor behind your hips, shoulder-width apart, with your fingers pointing toward your feet.
Straighten your arms, brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press through your palms and heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Keep your shoulders directly over your hands, open your chest and look up at the ceiling with your head in line with your body.
Hold the position for the set time, breathing steadily.
Lower your hips back to the floor under control.

name: Anderson Squat
instructions: Set the safety pins in a power rack at a height where your thighs are parallel to the ground when you are in the bottom squat position.
Position the barbell on the safety pins and load it with an appropriate weight.
Stand under the barbell, positioning it across your upper back, and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and grip the bar firmly with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the pins, extending your hips and knees until you reach a standing position.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the barbell back to the pins with control.
Reset your position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Depth Jump
instructions: Stand tall on a stable plyo box, close to its front edge, feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Step forward off the box with one foot and let your body drop straight down. Do not jump up or out.
Land on the balls of both feet at the same time, just in front of the box, with your knees and hips bent and your arms swung back.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your chest up as you touch down.
Rebound at once: spend as little time on the floor as possible, drive through your feet and swing your arms forward and up.
Jump straight up as high as you can, fully extending your hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly with your knees and hips bent, stand up, then step back onto the box for the next rep.

name: Roll Foot
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or sturdy support you can hold for balance.
Place a foam roller on the floor and put one foot on it, with the arch of the foot over the roller.
Shift some of your weight onto that foot and roll slowly from the heel to the toes and back.
Pause on any tight or tender areas for a few seconds.
Continue rolling for 1-2 minutes per foot.
Switch to the other foot and repeat the process.

name: Copenhagen Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side next to a flat bench, with your forearm on the floor and your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Place the inside of your top foot on the bench with the leg straight, and rest the bottom leg on the floor under the bench.
Rest your free hand on your opposite shoulder and brace your core.
Press the top leg down into the bench and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
As your hips rise, raise the straight bottom leg until it meets the underside of the bench.
Pause briefly, then lower your hips and bottom leg under control until your hips are just above the floor.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

name: Band Standing Leg Curl (Under Foot)
instructions: Step on a loop band with one foot and slip the other end around the opposite ankle.
Stand tall with your feet close together and your hands on your hips. The foot on the band is your supporting leg.
Shift your weight onto the supporting leg, keep a slight bend in that knee and brace your core.
Keep the working knee next to the supporting knee, pointing down.
Bend the working knee and curl your heel back toward your glute, stretching the band.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the foot slowly until it is back beside the other foot.
Complete all reps on one leg, then switch the band and repeat with the other leg.

name: Hopping High Knee Tap
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Engage your core and maintain an upright posture throughout the exercise.
Lift your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously hopping on your left foot.
As you lift your knee, tap it with your left hand.
Quickly switch legs, lifting your left knee and tapping it with your right hand while hopping on your right foot.
Continue alternating knees in a rhythmic and controlled manner for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

name: Pin Front Squat
instructions: Set the safety pins in a power rack at a height that allows you to squat to parallel or slightly below.
Position the barbell on the safety pins and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, elbows pointing forward, and position it across your shoulders, resting on your deltoids.
Engage your core and lift the barbell off the pins by extending your legs to stand up straight.
Initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees, lowering your body until the barbell lightly touches the pins.
Pause briefly at the bottom, maintaining tension in your muscles.
Drive through your heels to extend your hips and knees, returning to a standing position.

name: Side Lying Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Lie down on your side on a flat surface, ensuring your body is in a straight line.
Support your head with your lower arm or rest it on the floor.
Bend your top knee and bring your heel towards your glutes.
Reach back with your top hand and grasp your ankle or foot.
Gently pull your ankle towards your glutes until you feel a stretch in the front of your thigh.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, maintaining steady breathing.
Release slowly and switch sides to repeat the stretch on the other leg.

name: Stability Ball Wall Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, positioning a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Lean back slightly against the ball, ensuring it is secure and stable.
Engage your core muscles and keep your chest up.
Slowly bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your knees aligned with your toes.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as comfortable without losing form.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the squat.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping the movement controlled.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Paused Squat
instructions: Place the bar across your upper back, grip it firmly and extend your legs to lift it out of the rack.
Step back one or two small steps and place your feet about shoulder width apart, with your toes turned slightly out.
Take a deep breath into your abdomen and brace your trunk as if preparing for a punch.
Start the squat by bending at the hips and knees together.
Lower under control until your hip crease is at least level with the top of your knee, or to the deepest position you can maintain without losing spinal position or foot contact.
Hold the bottom position for the prescribed pause, usually one to three seconds.
Drive up by pushing the floor away through your midfoot.
Finish standing tall with your knees and hips fully extended.

name: Side Leg Swings
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold onto a stable object like a wall or a pole for support.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right leg slightly off the ground.
Swing your right leg gently across your body to the left, then out to the right side in a controlled manner.
Keep your torso upright and engage your core to maintain balance.
Perform 10-15 swings on one leg before switching to the other leg.

name: Roll Calves
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place a foam roller under your calves, just above the ankles.
Lift your hips off the ground by supporting yourself with your hands placed behind you.
Slowly roll your calves over the foam roller from the ankles to just below the knees.
Pause on any tight spots for a few seconds to allow the muscle to release.
Continue rolling for 1-2 minutes or until you feel a reduction in muscle tension.

name: Happy Baby Pose
instructions: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor.
Bend your knees towards your chest, keeping your feet flexed.
Reach your hands to the outside edges of your feet.
Open your knees wider than your torso and pull them towards your armpits.
Ensure your ankles are directly over your knees, creating a 90-degree angle at the knee joint.
Gently press your tailbone down towards the floor while keeping your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold the pose for 30 seconds to 1 minute, breathing deeply.

name: Ring Leg Curl
instructions: Set the gymnastic rings to a low height, just above the ground.
Lie on your back with your heels placed in the rings, legs extended and arms at your sides for balance.
Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips off the ground into a bridge position.
Bend your knees to pull your heels towards your glutes, keeping your hips elevated.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring maximum contraction of the hamstrings.
Slowly extend your legs back to the starting position while maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying Butterfly Pose
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended.
Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall open to the sides.
Position your heels comfortably close to your pelvis.
Rest your arms alongside your body with palms facing up or place them on your abdomen.
Close your eyes and take slow, deep breaths, allowing your body to relax into the pose.
Hold the position for 3-5 minutes or as long as comfortable.

name: Patrick Step
instructions: Stand on a low step or sturdy platform with one foot fully supported near the front edge. Let the other leg hang straight in front of the platform.
Keep your standing knee tracking in line with your toes and hold your chest tall. Lightly brace your abdomen.
Slowly bend the standing knee and lower your body straight down until the heel of the free leg gently touches the floor in front of the platform.
Keep most of the pressure through the whole foot of the working leg. Do not let the knee collapse inward or the heel lift off the step.
Press through the working foot to straighten the leg and return to the starting position without pushing off the floor with the free leg.
Complete all repetitions on one side, then switch legs. Use a lower step or hold a support if you cannot control the descent.

name: Recumbent Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the farthest point of each pedal stroke, without locking out.
Set the backrest to support your lower back comfortably, then place the balls of your feet on the pedals and secure the straps.
Sit back with your hips against the seat, shoulders relaxed, chest up, and hands resting lightly on the handles.
Start pedalling at a steady pace and adjust resistance to your planned effort.
Push through the balls of your feet on each pedal stroke and keep your knees tracking in line with your toes.
Breathe steadily throughout the interval and reduce the resistance if you cannot maintain smooth pedaling.

name: Barbell Forward Lunge
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at upper-chest height, position it across your upper traps, and grip it securely just outside shoulder width.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, brace your core, keep your chest lifted, and take the barbell out of the rack.
Step forward with one leg, placing the whole foot firmly on the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your back knee is close to the floor and your front thigh is approximately parallel to the ground.
Keep your front knee tracking in line with your toes and avoid allowing it to collapse inward or travel excessively forward.
Drive through the heel and midfoot of the front foot to push yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions on one side, then perform the same number of repetitions with the opposite leg forward.
Return the barbell to the rack safely after completing the set.

name: Dumbbell Swing
instructions: Hinge at your hips, bend your knees slightly, and grip one end of the dumbbell with both hands. Keep your back flat and your chest open.
Pull the dumbbell back between your legs, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders packed down.
Extend your hips forcefully to swing the dumbbell to shoulder height.
Let the dumbbell move from the power of your hips, not by lifting with your arms or squatting deeply.
At the top, stand tall with your glutes tight, ribs down, and arms straight in front of you.
Let the dumbbell fall back under control, then hinge at the hips as it passes between your legs.
Repeat with a steady rhythm. Keep your spine neutral throughout and stop if you feel pain in your lower back.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about an arm's length away, and place both hands on it at shoulder height.
Take a short step back with one foot. Point both feet straight at the wall.
Straighten the back leg and press its heel firmly into the floor.
Bend the front knee and move your hips toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf of the back leg.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to back heel, with your hips facing the wall.
Hold the position for the planned time and breathe calmly.
Bring your feet together and repeat with the other leg back.

name: Double Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a kettlebell in each hand.
Hold the kettlebells near the sides of your legs with straight arms and brace your abdomen.
Keep your knees slightly bent and send your hips backward.
Lower both kettlebells close to your legs as your torso inclines forward.
Stop at a depth that preserves a neutral back, then press through your feet.
Extend your hips to stand tall and finish without leaning back.

name: Band Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart. Hold one end in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
Stand tall with a soft bend in your knees, brace your stomach and set your shoulders down and back.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward, keeping your back flat and the band close to your legs.
Lower your hands toward mid-shin until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Finish tall with your ribs over your pelvis, without leaning back.
Lower into the next repetition slowly, resisting the pull of the band.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing each other and elbows pointing forward.
Brace your abs, lift your chest and look straight ahead.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down, keeping your heels on the floor and the dumbbells at your shoulders.
Lower yourself until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, with your back flat and your knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your whole foot and stand up powerfully, straightening your hips and knees.
As your legs straighten, carry that drive into the press and push both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight and the weights are over your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells under control to your shoulders and move straight into the next squat.

name: Wall Ball Shot
instructions: Stand facing a wall about half a step away, feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly out.
Hold the medicine ball at chest height with both hands on its sides, slightly underneath, and your elbows pointing down.
Brace your core and squat until your hips drop below your knees. Keep your chest up and your heels on the floor.
Drive up explosively through your whole foot and fully extend your hips and knees.
Carry that momentum into your arms and throw the ball to the target on the wall, finishing with your arms extended overhead.
Catch the ball at chest height with bent elbows as it comes down.
As you catch it, sink straight into the next squat and repeat until the set is done.

name: Trap Bar Jump Squat
instructions: Stand in the center of the trap bar with your feet about hip-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grasp the handles with a neutral grip, keeping your chest lifted, back flat, and shoulders pulled down.
Lower into a squat with the plates near the floor, keeping your arms straight.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles to jump vertically, allowing the trap bar to travel with your body while keeping your torso stable.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, then lower your heels as you bend your knees and hips, absorbing the impact quietly while keeping a neutral spine and control of the handles.
Reset your position and balance between repetitions, and stop the set if you cannot land safely or maintain an explosive, controlled jump.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and place one heel on the floor slightly in front of you, keeping that leg straight with the toes pointing up.
Keep a small bend in the standing knee and square your hips forward.
Hinge forward from your hips toward the extended leg, keeping your back long and chest open.
Reach your hands toward your shin, ankle, or foot only as far as you can without rounding your lower back or forcing the stretch.
Hold the stretch while breathing steadily, feeling it along the back of the extended thigh.
Return to standing slowly, then repeat on the other side.

name: Hang Clean
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold the barbell against your thighs with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart and arms straight.
Push your hips back and bend your knees slightly until the bar sits at mid-thigh. Keep your back flat, chest up and shoulders slightly in front of the bar.
Drive through the floor and extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively, keeping your arms straight and the bar close to your thighs.
At full extension, shrug and pull yourself down under the bar, keeping it close to your body as your elbows bend.
Move your feet out to about shoulder width, drop into a squat and quickly turn your elbows forward around the bar.
Catch the bar on the front of your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward, chest up and hips at about knee height.
Stand up from the squat with the bar on your shoulders until your hips and knees are straight.
Lower the bar under control back to your thighs and reset the hang for the next rep.

name: Power Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, with the barbell over the middle of your feet. Take a wide snatch grip, so the bar sits in your hip crease when you stand tall with straight arms, using a hook grip if comfortable.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees until your shoulders are slightly in front of the bar. Keep your chest up, back neutral, arms straight, and eyes forward.
Push through the floor to lift the bar smoothly, keeping it close to your shins and thighs. Extend your knees first while maintaining your back angle.
As the bar passes your knees, forcefully extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving upward explosively and shrugging your shoulders while keeping the bar close to your body.
Pull yourself under the bar by quickly rotating your elbows underneath it, then catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a partial squat. Keep your torso upright and knees tracking over your toes.
Stabilize the bar directly over your shoulders and mid-foot, then stand fully upright with your hips and knees locked out.
Lower the bar under control to the hips and then to the floor, or drop it safely if using appropriate bumper plates and a designated lifting area.

name: Couch Stretch
aliases: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch on Bench
instructions: Kneel with your back to a flat bench and place the top of one foot on the bench, with that knee on the floor at the base of the bench and the shin upright.
Step the other foot forward and plant it flat, with the front knee bent to about 90 degrees over the ankle.
Reach back and place both hands on the bench, arms straight.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and squeeze the glute of the rear leg.
Lift your chest and bring your torso upright, leaning back slightly onto your hands, until you feel a stretch along the front of the rear hip and thigh.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back neutral for the whole hold.
Hold for the set time while breathing calmly, then switch legs.

name: Bodyweight Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand tall with your feet close together and your arms hanging by your sides. Shift your weight onto one foot and keep a slight bend in that knee.
Brace your core and start the movement by pushing your hips back while the free leg slides straight back behind you.
