Continue the movement until your hands are near your opposite hip.
Slowly return to the starting position by reversing the motion, maintaining control throughout.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie flat on a bench or the floor with your head near the edge. Grip the sides of the bench or anchor your hands behind your head for support.
Engage your core and lift your legs and hips off the bench, keeping your body straight from shoulders to toes.
Maintain a rigid body position as you slowly lower your legs towards the bench without letting your back arch.
Pause just above the bench, then raise your legs back to the starting position using controlled movements.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining form.

name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your lower back pressed to the ground.
Place your hands behind your head, elbows wide, without pulling on your neck.
Lift your knees to a 90-degree angle, keeping your feet off the ground.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the mat.
Simultaneously extend your right leg out while bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
Switch sides by extending your left leg and bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner, simulating a pedaling motion.
Perform for the desired number of repetitions or time.

name: Weighted Dead Bug
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms extended towards the ceiling, holding a dumbbell or weight plate in both hands.
Lift your legs off the ground, bending your knees at a 90-degree angle so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor.
Engage your core by pulling your belly button towards your spine.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the floor simultaneously, keeping your lower back pressed against the mat.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and arms stretched overhead.
Engage your core by pulling your belly button towards your spine.
Simultaneously lift your legs and upper body off the ground, reaching your hands towards your feet.
Keep your legs straight and try to form a 'V' shape with your body at the top of the movement.
Hold the position briefly, ensuring your core remains engaged.
Slowly lower your arms and legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Machine Trunk Rotation
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when seated.
Sit on the machine with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms across your chest or hold onto the handles if available.
Engage your core muscles by pulling your navel towards your spine.
Rotate your torso to one side as far as comfortable, keeping your hips stable.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side.
Perform equal repetitions for both sides.

name: Seated Knee Tuck
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench and grip its edges just behind your hips.
Lean your torso back slightly and brace your abs.
Lift your feet off the floor and extend your legs until they are almost straight.
Exhale and pull your knees in toward your chest, bringing your torso slightly forward to meet them.
Pause briefly when your knees are closest to your chest.
Inhale and push your legs back out as you lean your torso back.
Stop with your heels just above the floor and go straight into the next rep.

name: Weighted Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Hold a weight with both hands close to your chest.
Lean back slightly, keeping your spine straight and core engaged.
Lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your sit bones. Maintain this position throughout the exercise.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight beside your hip. Keep your arms slightly bent.
Return to the center, then twist to the left side in a controlled manner.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Ab Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest with both hands.
Engage your core by pulling your navel towards your spine.
Exhale as you lift your head, shoulders, and upper back off the floor in a controlled motion.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your lower back remains in contact with the mat.
Inhale as you slowly lower back to the starting position without letting your head touch the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Knee Tuck Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and arms at your sides.
Place your hands lightly behind your head for support, keeping elbows wide.
Engage your core by drawing your belly button towards your spine.
Simultaneously lift your knees towards your chest while curling your upper body off the ground.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abs tightly.
Slowly lower back to the starting position, keeping control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rotary Torso
instructions: Adjust the seat height on the lever machine so that the pivot point aligns with your midsection.
Sit down and secure your feet under the foot pads, ensuring your knees are slightly bent.
Grasp the handles firmly with both hands, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your core muscles and maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.
Slowly rotate your torso to one side, using your oblique muscles to control the motion.
Pause briefly at the end of the rotation to maximize muscle engagement.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side to complete one full repetition.

name: Leg In and Out
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and your hands placed slightly behind your hips for support.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your sit bones.
Simultaneously bring your knees towards your chest while keeping your core tight.
Extend your legs back out to the starting position without letting them touch the ground.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control and balance throughout.

name: Weighted Straight Arm Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands, extending your arms straight above your chest.
Engage your core by pulling your navel towards your spine.
Lift your shoulders and upper back off the mat, keeping your arms straight and reaching towards the ceiling.
Hold the contraction at the top for a moment, then slowly lower back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Bench Leg Raises
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with your head at the higher end and your legs extended off the lower end.
Grip the sides of the bench for stability.
Keep your legs straight and together, then lift them towards your chest by flexing at the hips.
Raise your legs until they are perpendicular to your torso, or as high as you comfortably can.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position without letting them touch the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Sit Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest with both hands.
Engage your core muscles by drawing your belly button towards your spine.
Exhale as you lift your upper body off the floor in a controlled manner, curling your torso towards your knees.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your core remains engaged.
Inhale as you slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the descent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Band Pallof Press
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a stable anchor point at chest height.
Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handle with both hands at the center of your chest.
Step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Engage your core and glutes to maintain a stable posture.
Press the band straight out in front of you, keeping your arms parallel to the floor.
Hold the extended position briefly while resisting rotation.
Slowly return your hands to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Scissors
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and arms at your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your core by pulling your navel towards your spine and lift both legs off the ground about 6 inches.
Keep your head, neck, and shoulders relaxed on the mat.
Begin the movement by lifting one leg higher while lowering the other leg towards the ground without touching it.
Alternate legs in a controlled manner, mimicking a scissor motion.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions or time, maintaining core engagement throughout.

name: Kneeling Band Abs Crunches
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a high anchor point above your head.
Kneel on the floor facing the anchor point, holding the band handles with both hands.
Position your hands behind your head, keeping your elbows wide.
Engage your core and lean slightly forward to create tension in the band.
Exhale as you contract your abs, pulling your chest towards your knees in a crunching motion.
Hold the contraction briefly, then slowly return to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Plank
instructions: Begin in a standard plank position with your forearms on the ground and elbows directly under your shoulders.
Ensure your body forms a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core and glutes.
Have a partner carefully place a weight plate on your lower back, ensuring it is centered and stable.
Maintain the plank position, keeping your core tight and avoiding any sagging or arching of the back.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then have your partner remove the weight before lowering your knees to the ground.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands placed shoulder-width apart directly under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core muscles.
Drive your right knee towards your chest while keeping your left leg extended.
Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest as you extend your right leg back.
Continue alternating legs at a quick pace, maintaining the plank position throughout the exercise.
Breathe steadily and maintain a consistent rhythm.

name: Weighted Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat. If you use a medicine ball (2–4 kg), squeeze it between your shins just above the ankles.
Grip a light plate (2.5–5 kg to start) by the rim, one hand on each side, and press it up over your chest, arms straight.
Tilt your pelvis back until your lower back presses flat into the mat. That contact comes first; nothing leaves the floor before it.
Curl your head and shoulder blades up, chin slightly tucked, then take the plate back until your upper arms are beside your ears.
Raise your straight legs until your heels hover 15–30 cm off the floor, the lowest height at which your lower back stays down.
Now hold still: elbows locked, legs pressed together, toes pointed. Take short breaths behind a braced stomach and don't let it bulge.
When time is up, bring the plate back over your chest first, then bend your knees, lower your legs and head and set it down.

name: Swiss Ball Plank
instructions: Begin by placing your forearms on a Swiss ball, ensuring your elbows are directly under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the ground, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core by pulling your belly button towards your spine.
Maintain a neutral neck position by looking slightly ahead of you.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time, ensuring your hips do not sag or rise.

name: Janda Sit Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head, keeping your elbows wide.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings by having a partner hold your ankles or using a resistance band around them to create tension.
Exhale and slowly curl your torso up towards your knees, focusing on contracting your abdominal muscles.
Pause at the top of the movement, ensuring maximum contraction of the abs.
Inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the descent.

name: Cable Horizontal Pallof Press
instructions: Attach a single handle to a cable machine at chest height.
Stand perpendicular to the cable machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handle with both hands and step away from the machine to create tension in the cable.
Position your hands at the center of your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your core and press the handle straight out in front of you, extending your arms fully.
Hold the extended position briefly, ensuring your torso remains stable and does not rotate.
Slowly return your hands to the starting position at your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Landmine Twist
instructions: Secure one end of a barbell in a landmine attachment or corner of the room.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the other end of the barbell with both hands at chest level.
Extend your arms fully in front of you, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
Engage your core and rotate your torso to one side, pivoting on the opposite foot.
Return to the starting position by rotating back to the center.
Repeat the movement to the other side, maintaining control throughout.
Perform the desired number of repetitions on each side.

name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Begin by gripping a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended and legs straight.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest.
As you lift your knees, twist your torso to one side to target the obliques.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring maximum contraction.
Lower your legs back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat the movement, alternating sides with each repetition.

name: L-Sit
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and your hands placed on the ground beside your hips.
Engage your core muscles and press your hands firmly into the ground to lift your body off the floor.
Keep your legs straight and parallel to the ground, forming an 'L' shape with your body.
Hold this position for as long as possible, maintaining steady breathing throughout.
Lower yourself back to the starting position with control.

name: Band Twist (horizontal)
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a stable anchor point at shoulder height.
Stand sideways to the anchor point with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handle with both hands, arms extended in front of you.
Engage your core and maintain a slight bend in your knees.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor point, keeping your arms straight.
Return to the starting position with control.
Perform the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Incline Twisting Sit Up
instructions: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle, typically between 30 to 45 degrees.
Sit on the bench and secure your feet under the foot pads.
Lie back with your hands placed behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the bench, twisting your torso to one side as you ascend.
Reach the top of the movement with your elbow pointing towards the opposite knee.
Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat the movement, alternating sides with each repetition.

name: Knee Raise Ab Coaster
instructions: Load the plate, or set the pin, while the platform rests at the bottom. Start light: the long lever makes even one plate feel heavy.
Kneel on the platform facing the arm pads, shins flat and knees at the front edge, with your feet hanging off the back.
Lean forward and lay your forearms along the pads, elbows at the back end under your shoulders, hands on the handles with palms facing in. Your torso ends up about 45° forward.
Press your forearms lightly into the pads, pull your shoulders away from your ears and keep your ribs down.
Breathe out and tuck your tailbone under first, then drive your knees forward and up toward your chest. The platform swings up with you.
Stop when your thighs are about level with your hips and your lower back has rounded. Hold for a second and squeeze your lower stomach.
Take 2–3 seconds to lower the platform to the start without letting the plate bang. After the last rep, let it settle at the bottom before you climb off.

name: Standing Cable Ab Crunch
instructions: Clip a triceps rope to the high pulley of a cable column or lat-pulldown station.
Take a rope end in each hand, turn your back to the stack and step forward until the cable hangs just behind your head.
Bring your fists to your temples, palms facing in, with the rope behind your head and your bent elbows pointing forward and down.
Set your feet hip-width apart, toes forward, knees soft. Stand tall with your ribs down; the plates should already be off the stack.
Breathe out and curl from the top: chin in, upper back rounding, ribs pulling toward your pelvis, fists still glued to your temples.
Curl until your elbows reach your knees and your head is about knee height.
On the way, your hips slide back slightly and your knees bend a bit more.
Hold the squeeze for a second, uncurl over about 2 seconds and stop once you're upright. Start the next rep before the plates touch down.
When the set is done, step back toward the column until the weight rests, then let go. Released at your head, the rope whips straight up.

name: Bear Plank
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Tuck your toes under and lift your knees off the ground, keeping them bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core by pulling your belly button towards your spine.
Keep your back flat and maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time, ensuring steady breathing.

name: Seated Ab Cable Crunch
instructions: Clip a triceps rope to the high pulley of a cable column or lat-pulldown station. Go light at first; sitting down with the rope takes practice.
Put a flat bench in front of the column. Take the rope while standing, then sit down with your back to the stack.
Hold one rope end in each hand at your temples, palms facing each other and elbows pointing forward. The rope runs behind your head.
Sit tall near the front edge of the bench, feet flat and hip-width apart, knees at about 90°. The plates should already be lifted.
Breathe out and curl: pull your ribs toward your pelvis, tuck your chin and round your back from the top down.
Curl until your chest rests on your thighs and your elbows reach your knees. Squeeze for a second, fists still at your temples.
Uncurl over 2–3 seconds and stop the moment you sit tall. Start the next rep before the plates touch down.
To finish, sit tall and let your hands rise slowly toward the pulley until the weight rests. Then let go of the rope.

name: Cat Cow
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Exhale deeply, round your back toward the ceiling while tucking your chin to your chest, resembling a cat stretching its back.
Hold the 'Cat' position for a moment, feeling the stretch along your spine.
Inhale slowly, drop your belly toward the floor and lift your head and tailbone upward into the 'Cow' position.
Hold the 'Cow' position briefly, allowing your spine to extend fully.
Repeat the sequence for 8-10 breaths, moving fluidly between each position.

name: Hanging Knee Raises
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and hang with your arms fully extended and legs straight.
Slowly lift your knees towards your chest by flexing at the hips.
Keep your back straight and avoid swinging or using momentum.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement when your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Lower your legs back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Side Bridge
instructions: Begin by lying on your side on an exercise mat. Stack your feet on top of each other and extend your legs fully.
Place your bottom hand on the floor directly under your shoulder with the arm straight, and rest your top hand on your hip.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting it against your hip.
Engage your core muscles and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Maintain this position while keeping the dumbbell stable for the desired duration.
Lower your hips back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the specified number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Seated Alternate Crunches
instructions: Sit on the edge of a flat bench and place your hands on the bench just behind your hips.
Lean back slightly and extend both legs forward with your heels close to the floor.
Brace your core and keep your chest open and your back straight.
Bend one knee and draw it towards your chest while bringing your torso slightly forward to meet it.
Extend the leg back out and lean back to the starting position under control.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Low Cable Horizontal Pallof Press
instructions: Attach a handle to a low pulley cable machine and set the desired weight.
Stand sideways to the machine with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handle with both hands close to your chest.
Step away from the machine to create tension in the cable. Ensure your body is aligned and your knees are slightly bent.
Engage your core and press the handle straight out in front of you, keeping your arms extended at shoulder height.
Hold the extended position briefly, resisting any rotation or movement in your torso.
Slowly return the handle to your chest while maintaining control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise to ensure balanced development.

name: Hanging Knees to Elbows
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended and feet off the ground.
Engage your core by pulling your belly button towards your spine.
Inhale deeply, then exhale as you lift your knees towards your elbows.
Keep the movement controlled, avoiding swinging or using momentum.
Pause briefly when your knees are close to your elbows.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position while maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Stability Ball Crunch
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Walk your feet forward and roll your back onto the ball until your lower back is supported and your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows wide, or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core by pulling your navel towards your spine.
Exhale as you lift your upper body off the ball, curling your shoulders towards your hips.
Pause at the top of the movement for a moment, ensuring maximum contraction of the abs.
Inhale as you slowly lower back down to the starting position, maintaining tension in your core.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Machine Lying Crunch
instructions: Adjust the machine settings to fit your body size, ensuring the back pad and foot placement are comfortable.
Lie down on the machine with your back firmly against the pad and your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grip the handles or place your hands across your chest, depending on the machine design.
Engage your core by pulling your navel towards your spine.
Exhale as you contract your abdominal muscles to lift your upper body towards your knees.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring maximum contraction of the abs.
Inhale as you slowly return to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the descent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dead Bug with Ball
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling, holding a stability ball between your hands and knees.
Engage your core by drawing your belly button towards your spine.
Simultaneously lower your right arm and left leg towards the floor while keeping the ball stable between your opposite hand and knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side, lowering your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining control of the ball.

name: Hanging Knees to Elbows Waist
instructions: Begin by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body stable, avoiding swinging.
Lift your knees towards your elbows by flexing at the hips and contracting your abdominal muscles.
Aim to bring your knees as close to your elbows as possible while maintaining control.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position, maintaining tension in your core.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: V-Sit Crunch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and your arms at your sides.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and engage your core.
Lift your legs off the ground, bending your knees slightly.
Simultaneously lift your torso to form a 'V' shape with your body.
Hold this position briefly, ensuring your core remains engaged.
Lower your torso and legs back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Shoulderstand Pose
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms at your sides and legs extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs towards the ceiling, keeping them straight.
Place your hands on your lower back for support as you lift your hips off the ground.
Continue to raise your legs and torso until they form a straight line perpendicular to the floor.
Keep your chin tucked slightly to protect your neck and hold the position for several breaths.
To release, slowly lower your back and legs to the floor in a controlled manner.

name: Hanging Leg Raise To Bar
instructions: Begin by gripping a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body stable, avoiding swinging.
With legs straight, lift them towards the bar by flexing at the hips.
Aim to touch the bar with your feet while keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Side Crunch
instructions: Lie on your side on a mat with your knees bent and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm extended on the floor for support and your top hand behind your head.
Engage your core by pulling your belly button towards your spine.
Lift your upper body towards your hip, contracting your obliques.
Hold the contraction for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Toe Touches
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and keep your hips level with your shoulders.
Lift one foot and drive that knee under your body toward the opposite side.
Lift the opposite hand and reach under your body to touch the foot of the bent leg, letting your hips rise slightly.
Return the hand and the foot to the floor and reset the plank.
Repeat with the other leg and hand, alternating sides for the planned number of repetitions.

name: Hanging Half Windmill
instructions: Begin by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lift your legs to a 90-degree angle, so your body forms an 'L' shape.
Slowly rotate your legs to one side while keeping them straight, aiming to bring them parallel to the ground.
Pause briefly at the end of the rotation, maintaining control and tension in your core.
Return your legs to the center position in a controlled manner.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side.
Perform the desired number of repetitions, ensuring even distribution on both sides.

name: Seated Flutter Kick
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or sturdy surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands slightly behind your hips for support, keeping your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Lift both legs off the ground a few inches while keeping them straight.
Begin to alternate kicking your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, keeping the movement controlled and steady.
Continue the flutter kicks for the desired number of repetitions or time duration.

name: Saw Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
Shift your body weight forward by pushing through your toes, moving your shoulders past your elbows.
Reverse the motion by pulling back with your toes, bringing your shoulders behind your elbows.
Continue this sawing motion for the desired number of repetitions or time.

name: Weighted Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Begin by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Ensure your body is fully extended and your feet are off the ground.
Secure a dumbbell or weight plate between your feet or use ankle weights.
Engage your core and bend your knees as you raise them toward your chest, lifting your thighs at least parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your core is tight.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Opposite side elbow to knee
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head, elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your core by pulling your belly button towards your spine.
Lift your head, shoulders, and upper back off the ground while simultaneously bringing your right elbow towards your left knee, twisting through the torso.
Extend your right leg out straight as you bring your elbow to your knee.
Return to the starting position with control, then repeat on the opposite side by bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bodyweight Windmill
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, forming a T-shape with your body.
Shift your weight onto your right leg, bending your right knee slightly while keeping your left leg straight.
Rotate your torso to the right, lowering your left hand towards your right foot while keeping your right arm extended upwards.
Keep your gaze on your right hand as you hinge at the hips and maintain a straight back.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, then return to the starting position by reversing the motion.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side, shifting weight onto your left leg and lowering your right hand towards your left foot.

name: Band Standing Side Bend
instructions: Anchor a resistance band low, near the floor, and stand side-on to the anchor with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the free end of the band in the hand nearest the anchor, with your arm straight down at your side.
Keep your other hand on your hip or let it hang naturally by your side.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Let the band draw you into a side bend towards the anchor under control, feeling a stretch along the opposite side of your waist.
Bend back up and slightly away from the anchor by contracting the obliques on the side away from the band.
Pause briefly at the top, then return under control into the side bend towards the anchor.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Barbell Standing Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Place a barbell across your upper back, gripping it with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Engage your core and keep your chest up.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping your hips facing forward.
Return to the starting position and then rotate to the left.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hanging Knee Circles
instructions: Start by gripping a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest.
Begin to move your knees in a circular motion, first clockwise for a set number of repetitions.
Reverse the direction and move your knees counterclockwise for the same number of repetitions.
Maintain a controlled motion throughout the exercise, avoiding swinging or using momentum.

name: Frog Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall outward, forming a diamond shape with your legs.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows wide, or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core by drawing your navel towards your spine.
Exhale as you lift your head, shoulders, and upper back off the ground in a controlled crunching motion.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Inhale as you slowly lower back to the starting position without letting your head touch the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: High To Low Band Woodchopper
instructions: Anchor a resistance band at a high point above your head.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, perpendicular to the anchor point.
Grasp the band with both hands, arms fully extended above one shoulder.
Engage your core and rotate your torso as you pull the band diagonally across your body.
Finish the movement by bringing your hands down towards the opposite knee, keeping arms straight.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Suspension V-Ups
instructions: Attach the suspension trainer securely overhead and adjust the straps to mid-calf length.
Place your feet in the foot cradles and walk your hands out into a high plank, hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Brace your core and, keeping your legs straight, lift your hips toward the ceiling while pulling your feet toward your hands.
Stop when your hips are high above your shoulders and your body forms an upside-down V.
Lower your hips under control back to the plank position without letting them sag.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Upward Dog
instructions: Begin by lying face down on the mat with your legs extended straight back and the tops of your feet resting on the floor.
Place your hands under your shoulders with your elbows close to your body.
Inhale deeply and press firmly into your palms to lift your chest off the ground.
Straighten your arms completely while keeping your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.
Engage your thighs and lift your knees off the floor, balancing on the tops of your feet.
Hold the pose for several breaths, keeping your gaze forward or slightly upward.
Exhale and slowly lower your body back to the starting position.

name: Hanging Scissors Kicks
instructions: Begin by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body straight, avoiding any swinging.
Lift your legs slightly in front of you to start.
Raise one straight leg to about hip height while the other stays low, then switch legs in a smooth scissor motion, keeping the toes pointed.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions or time duration.

name: Band Standing Twisting Crunches
instructions: Loop the band around something high and solid behind you: the top of a power rack, a pull-up bar or a door anchor at the top of a closed door.
Stand with your back to the anchor, feet hip-width and knees soft.
Step forward until the band is taut while you stand tall, hips stacked over your feet.
Bring the band over your shoulders and hold the ends in your fists at the sides of your neck, just above the collarbones.
Point your elbows down in front of your chest; your hands stay parked there until the set is over.
Breathe out and curl your ribs toward your pelvis while turning one shoulder down and across, as if taking your right elbow to the outside of your left thigh.
Stop when your trunk is curled about 45° and clearly turned, and squeeze for a second. Hips, knees and feet don't move.
Breathe in and uncurl over 2–3 seconds, letting the band bring you back to tall standing but not past it into an arch.
On the next rep, curl and turn to the other side, or finish all reps to one side, then switch. Match the count and depth on both sides.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop
instructions: Adjust the cable pulley to a high position above your head.
Attach a handle to the cable and grasp it with both hands.
Kneel on the floor with the side of your body facing the cable machine, positioning your knees hip-width apart.
Engage your core muscles and maintain a straight back throughout the movement.
Start with your arms extended above your shoulder on the side of the cable machine.
Pull the handle down and across your body in a controlled motion, rotating your torso and bringing the handle toward the opposite hip.
Keep your arms extended and follow the movement with your torso rotation, avoiding excessive arm pulling.
Pause briefly at the end of the movement, feeling the contraction in your oblique muscles.
Slowly return the handle to the starting position with control, resisting the pull of the cable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides to work the opposite obliques.

name: Crab Pose
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind you, palms flat on the floor with fingers pointing towards your feet.
Engage your core and press through your hands and feet to lift your hips off the ground.
Align your torso parallel to the floor, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Keep your head in a neutral position or gently tilt it back if comfortable.
Hold this position for a few seconds while maintaining steady breathing.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.

name: Band Half Kneeling Chop
instructions: Anchor a resistance band above head height.
Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot flat on the ground, forming a 90-degree angle at both knees.
Hold the band with both hands, arms extended towards the anchor point.
Engage your core and rotate your torso, pulling the band diagonally across your body from high to low.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Perform the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Barbell Rollout - Kneeling
instructions: Begin by kneeling on the floor with a barbell in front of you. Grip the barbell with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight. Your shoulders should be directly over the barbell.
Slowly roll the barbell forward by extending your arms, keeping your core tight and preventing your lower back from sagging.
Roll out as far as you can while maintaining control and without compromising form.
Pause briefly at the extended position, then pull the barbell back to the starting position by contracting your core muscles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Band Kneeling Twisting Crunch
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a high anchor point above head height.
Kneel facing away from the anchor and hold the band ends with both hands beside your head.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Crunch down by rounding your spine and rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee, keeping your hands fixed beside your head.
Pause briefly at the end of the twist, ensuring maximum contraction of the obliques.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Lying Spinal Twist
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms stretched out to the sides, palms facing down.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your chest.
Gently guide your right knee across your body towards the left side, allowing your hips to rotate while keeping your shoulders flat on the ground.
Turn your head to the right, looking over your right shoulder to enhance the stretch.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and relaxing into the stretch.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Standing Russian Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Rotate your torso to one side while lifting one knee up and across toward your elbows, balancing on the other leg.
Lower the foot back to the wide stance as you turn back to the center.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating for the set time.

name: TRX Single Leg Bird Dog
instructions: Attach the TRX straps securely to an anchor point and adjust them to mid-calf length.
Kneel facing away from the anchor, place your feet in the foot cradles and set your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Brace your core and lift your knees to come into a forearm plank, with your body in a straight line from head to feet.
Keep one foot in its strap and lift the other leg up behind you while reaching the opposite arm straight forward.
Hold briefly, keeping your hips level and your trunk still.
Lower the arm and leg, then bring your knees back to the floor with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Abdominal Vacuum
instructions: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart or kneel on the floor.
Exhale completely to empty your lungs of air.
Draw your belly button inward towards your spine as much as possible.
Hold this position for 15-30 seconds while maintaining normal breathing.
Release and relax your abdominal muscles.
Repeat for 3-5 sets, gradually increasing hold time as you progress.

name: Band Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and a resistance band looped around both feet.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows wide, ensuring not to pull on your neck.
Lift your shoulders off the mat into a crunch position and simultaneously bring your right knee towards your chest while extending your left leg out straight.
Twist your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee, engaging your obliques.
Switch sides by extending your right leg and bringing your left knee towards your chest, twisting to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Barbell Twist
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at shoulder height, or use a light bar you can lift safely onto your back.
Place the bar across your upper back, below your neck, and hold it with a wide overhand grip.
Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor, a little wider than hip-width apart.
Sit tall, brace your core and keep your hips and knees facing forward.
Rotate your shoulders and torso to one side as far as you can without moving your hips.
Return through the center under control and rotate to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Band Standing Crunches
instructions: Secure a resistance band at an anchor point above head height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, facing the anchor point.
Hold the ends of the band with both hands, keeping your arms extended overhead.
Engage your core and slightly bend your knees.
Pull the band down by contracting your abs, bringing your elbows towards your knees.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, ensuring maximum contraction in the core.
Slowly return to the starting position, maintaining tension in the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Twisting Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows out to the sides.
Tighten your abs and press your lower back lightly into the floor.
Exhale and curl your head and shoulders off the floor, rotating your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly, then inhale and lower your upper back and head to the floor with control.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating until you finish the set.

name: Hanging Garhammer Raise
instructions: Find a pull-up bar or a sturdy overhead bar that can support your weight and allow you to hang freely.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and hang with your arms fully extended.
Bend your knees to about 90 degrees and lift your thighs slightly in front of you.
Engage your core and draw your knees up towards your chest, curling your pelvis up while avoiding any swinging.
Raise your knees as high as you can while keeping the knee angle about the same.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, focusing on contracting your abdominal muscles.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control, avoiding any swinging or jerking motions.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining proper form throughout the exercise.

name: Ring Pike
instructions: Adjust the gymnastic rings so they hang a few inches above the floor.
Place your feet in the rings and set your hands on the floor under your shoulders in a high plank position.
Keep your arms straight and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and, keeping your legs straight, lift your hips towards the ceiling to form an inverted V shape.
Pause briefly at the top with your head between your arms and your shoulders over your hands.
Slowly lower your hips back to the plank position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Toe Touch Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and raised toward the ceiling. Keep your feet about hip-width apart.
Extend your arms straight up toward your toes, with your palms facing inward.
Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your abdominal muscles.
Exhale as you lift your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching your hands toward your toes.
Keep your legs as still as possible and avoid pulling your head forward with your neck.
Pause briefly at the top when your abs are fully contracted.
Inhale as you lower your shoulders and upper back under control, then repeat.

name: Seated Reverse Circle Crunches
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lift your feet off the ground, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Begin to draw a circle in the air with your knees, moving them in a clockwise direction.
Complete the desired number of repetitions, then switch to a counterclockwise direction.
Maintain controlled breathing throughout the exercise.

name: Standing Air Bike
instructions: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lift your arms to shoulder height, bending elbows at 90 degrees.
Begin by lifting your right knee towards your left elbow while twisting your torso slightly.
Return to the starting position and immediately lift your left knee towards your right elbow.
Continue alternating sides in a rhythmic, pedaling motion.
Maintain a steady pace and focus on controlled movements.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the top of that foot on the floor, and plant the other foot flat a long step in front of you.
Keep the back knee bent to about 90 degrees and clasp your hands on top of the front knee.
Keep your torso tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed and ribs stacked over your pelvis.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg and tuck your pelvis slightly under, as if pulling your belt line up toward your ribs.
Keeping the pelvis tucked, slowly press your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip and thigh of the kneeling leg.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly.
Ease your hips back, switch legs and repeat on the other side.

name: 45-Degree Side Bend
instructions: Set the 45-degree back extension bench so the hip pad sits just below your hip on the side you are training.
Stand sideways on the bench with your feet secured under the ankle pads and your body in a straight line from head to feet.
Place both hands lightly behind your head without pulling your neck.
Brace your abdominal muscles and keep your hips square against the pad.
Lower your torso sideways toward the floor in a slow, controlled motion. Move only as far as you can without twisting your torso or losing control.
Contract the muscles along the side of your waist to raise your torso back until your body is straight again.
Complete all repetitions on one side, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

name: High Plank
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands on the floor directly under your shoulders and your fingers spread.
Step your feet back one at a time and straighten your legs so you are supported only on your hands and toes.
Straighten your arms and keep your shoulders stacked over your wrists.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes so your body forms one straight line from head to heels.
Push the floor away with your palms to keep your shoulder blades spread apart.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor just ahead of your hands.
Hold for the planned time while breathing steadily, then lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Set the decline bench to an angle you can control and hook your feet under the foot pads.
Lie back with your knees bent until your back and head rest on the bench.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows out to the sides.
Brace your abs and exhale as you curl up, lifting your head and shoulders first, then the rest of your back.
Keep rising until your torso is upright, with your elbows still wide.
Inhale and lower yourself slowly, rolling your back down onto the bench from the lower back to the shoulders.
Let your upper back and head touch the bench, then start the next rep.

name: GHD Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on the GHD pad with your hips near its front edge.
Secure your feet against the plate and your ankles between the rollers.
Start upright with your hands reaching toward your feet.
Lower your torso backward and reach your arms past your head toward the floor.
Use a depth you can control, then raise your torso with your abs and hip flexors.
Bring your hands toward your feet and finish upright before repeating.

name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your head on the bench and your hips near the other end, so your legs extend past it.
Keep your arms straight along your body with your palms flat on the bench beside your hips.
Straighten your legs, keep them together and hold them horizontal, in line with your body.
Brace your abs and press your lower back into the bench.
Exhale and raise your straight legs in a smooth arc until they point straight up at the ceiling. Keep your hips on the bench.
Inhale and lower your legs slowly until they are horizontal again. Do not rest them or let them drop below bench level.
Start the next rep from that position and repeat for the planned number of reps.

name: Horizontal Scissor Kicks
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and together, and slide your hands palms down under your hips.
Rest your head on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Brace your abs and press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both straight legs to about 30 to 45 degrees off the floor and point your toes.
Open your legs wide to the sides, keeping both at the same height.
Bring them back toward the center and cross one leg over the other.
Open again and cross with the other leg on top. Keep alternating for the whole set, then lower your legs to the floor with control.

name: Side Plank Hip Raise
instructions: Lie on your side with feet stacked, elbow under the shoulder and the upper hand behind your head.
Lift your hips into a side plank so your body forms a straight line from your head to your ankles. Keep your neck neutral and brace your abdominal muscles.
Lower your hips slowly toward the floor without letting your shoulder collapse or your torso rotate forward or backward.
Raise your hips back to the straight side plank position by squeezing the muscles along the side of your waist and your glutes.
Continue for the planned number of repetitions while keeping your elbow under your shoulder and your hips stacked.
Switch sides and repeat with the same controlled movement.

name: Dumbbell Plank Pull-Through
instructions: Place a dumbbell on the floor just outside your left hand. Set up in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders, legs straight and feet wider than hip width for balance.
Brace your core, squeeze your glutes and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor slightly ahead of your hands.
Shift your weight slightly into your left hand and feet without letting your hips rotate or sag.
Reach your right hand under your chest, grip the dumbbell, lift it slightly and carry it to the right side.
Place your right hand back under your shoulder and regain a stable plank position.
Shift your weight to the right hand and feet, then use the left hand to lift the dumbbell slightly and carry it back to the left side.
Continue alternating hands with controlled transfers and keep your hips and shoulders facing the floor.

name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
instructions: Stand side-on to a solid wall with feet about shoulder width apart.
Hold the ball in both hands near the hip away from the wall.
Bend your knees slightly and turn the hips and torso away from the target.
Drive through your feet and rotate toward the wall, letting the rear foot pivot.
Throw the ball into the wall with both hands and follow through with the rotation.
Catch or retrieve the ball and reset your stance before the next throw.
Complete the repetitions, then turn around and repeat in the opposite direction.

name: Plank Up-Down
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders, legs straight, and feet about hip width apart for stability.
Brace your stomach, squeeze your glutes and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Place one palm under its shoulder and press to straighten that arm, then repeat with the other hand to reach a high plank.
Lower one forearm to the floor directly under its shoulder, then lower the other forearm to move into a forearm plank.
Keep your hips as still as possible and avoid letting them sag, lift or rotate from side to side.
Continue alternating between high plank and forearm plank at a controlled pace.
Change the arm you lead with regularly so both sides work evenly.

name: Lying Windshield Wipers
instructions: Lie on your back and extend your arms to the sides at shoulder height.
Raise both straight legs above your hips and keep your feet together.
Brace your abdomen and keep both shoulders on the floor.
Lower your legs together toward one side, allowing your pelvis to rotate.
Stop before the opposite shoulder lifts, then bring your legs back above your hips.
Repeat to the other side while keeping your knees straight.

name: Plank Hip Dips
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your elbows below your shoulders, forearms on the floor and legs extended behind you.
Set your feet about hip width apart for more stability, or place them closer together to make the exercise harder.
Brace your stomach, squeeze your glutes, and keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Without letting your shoulders collapse, rotate your hips and lower one side toward the floor.
Stop just before your hip touches the floor, then use your obliques to return your hips to the center.
Rotate to the other side and lower the opposite hip toward the floor.
Continue alternating sides in a slow, controlled rhythm while keeping your elbows planted and your lower back from arching.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Tuck your toes under, brace your core and lift your knees off the floor. Keep them bent so your hips sit slightly above shoulder height.
Keep your arms straight, your back flat and your eyes on the floor just ahead of your hands.
Step your right hand and left foot forward at the same time, using a short step.
Step your left hand and right foot forward in the same way, keeping your hips level.
Keep alternating sides without letting your knees touch the floor.
Crawl for the set time, then lower your knees to the floor under control.

name: Otis-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, about hip-width apart. Hold a weight plate against your chest with both hands.
Brace your abs and sit up, keeping the plate on your chest and your feet on the floor.
When your torso is upright, press the plate overhead until your arms are straight and the plate is above your shoulders.
Pause briefly, sitting tall with your ribs down.
Bring the plate back to your chest, then lower your torso to the floor under control.
Let your shoulders touch the floor before you start the next rep.

name: Standing Oblique Crunch
aliases: Standing Elbow to Knee Side Crunch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet about hip-width apart.
Raise the working arm with the elbow bent and place the other hand on your hip.
Shift weight to the opposite leg and brace your abdomen.
Lift the working knee out to the side and bend the torso toward it, bringing the same-side elbow and knee closer.
Return the foot to the floor and straighten the torso under control.
Complete the repetitions, then change sides.

name: Squat Thrust
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders, arms straight and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Jump both feet forward together, driving your knees toward your chest.
Land softly in a deep crouch with your feet just behind your hands. Keep your hands flat on the floor.
Without pausing, jump both feet back and land in the high plank with your legs straight.
Repeat for the planned number of reps without lifting your hands off the floor.

name: Plank Alternating Leg Lift
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders, arms straight, and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Place your feet about hip width apart for balance. Brace your abdomen, squeeze your glutes, and keep your neck neutral by looking slightly ahead of your hands.
Shift your weight gently into both hands and your grounded foot without letting your hips rotate or sag.
Keeping your lifting leg straight, raise one foot a few inches off the floor by squeezing the glute. Do not lift so high that your lower back arches.
Pause briefly, then lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Lift the opposite leg in the same way, keeping your shoulders level and hips square to the floor.
Continue alternating legs for the prescribed repetitions or time, maintaining a stable plank position throughout.

name: Plank Jack
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders, arms straight, legs extended, and feet together. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abdominal muscles, squeeze your glutes, and keep your neck neutral by looking at the floor slightly in front of your hands.
Jump both feet out to the sides, about shoulder-width or slightly wider, while keeping your hands planted and hips level.
Immediately jump both feet back together and return to the starting plank position.
Continue jumping your feet out and in with a controlled rhythm. Keep your shoulders stable over your hands and avoid letting your lower back sag or hips lift.
Breathe steadily throughout the set. Step one foot out and in at a time instead of jumping if you need a lower-impact option.

name: Tuck-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead.
Brace your abdomen and keep your ribs drawn toward your pelvis.
Lift your torso while bending both knees toward your chest.
Reach both hands toward your shins and balance on your glutes in a compact seated position.
Lower your torso smoothly while extending your legs and returning your arms overhead.
Repeat without using a kick or swinging your arms to start the lift.

name: Pilates Hundred in V Position
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms beside you.
Brace your abdomen and raise the legs and shoulders into a hollow hold, reaching the arms overhead.
Raise your torso into the high V while keeping your straight legs at their raised angle, balancing through the pelvis.
Reach both arms toward your feet and keep the elbows straight.
Pump the arms in small movements while holding the torso and legs steady.
Breathe in for five pumps and out for five, then lower the body under control when finished.

name: High Knees
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your weight on the balls of your feet.
Bend your elbows and hold your hands in front of you at about hip height, palms facing down.
Drive one knee up until your thigh touches your hand and is about parallel to the floor.
Bring that foot down under your hip onto the ball of the foot and drive the other knee up right away.
Keep alternating legs in a fast running rhythm, heels off the floor and torso upright.
Continue for the set time, keeping your hands at the same height throughout.

name: Band Seated Twist
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with both feet firmly on the floor.
Secure the band to your side at chest height and hold the handle in both hands with arms straight in front of you.
Brace your abdominal muscles and keep your hips and legs still.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor point, pulling the band across your body.
Pause briefly at the end of the rotation without leaning back, rounding your lower back, or shrugging your shoulders.
Return slowly and with control to the starting position, resisting the pull of the band.
Complete all repetitions on one side, then turn around or move the anchor point and repeat on the other side.

name: Hollow Rock
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor by gently tucking your pelvis and tightening your abdominal muscles.
Lift your shoulders, arms and legs slightly off the floor, keeping your body in a curved hollow position.
Keep your ribs pulled down, your chin slightly tucked and your legs together.
Rock smoothly from your upper back toward your hips, using your core to control the movement.
Keep the range of motion small and controlled, then continue for the prescribed repetitions or time.

name: Six-Inch Hold
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your legs straight.
Grip the bench edges beside your hips.
Brace your abdomen and keep your lower back supported.
Lift both legs slightly above the bench and raise your head and shoulders.
Hold your legs and upper body still while breathing steadily.
Lower your legs, head and shoulders under control to finish.

name: Kneeling Plank
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your forearms down with your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Lift your feet off the floor, keeping the knees supported.
Walk your knees back until your body forms a straight line from your head through your hips to your knees.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and squeeze your glutes to prevent your lower back from arching.
Brace your abdominal muscles as if preparing for a light punch, while keeping your ribs pulled down.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor slightly in front of your hands.
Hold with steady breathing, then shift your hips back to leave the position.

name: Wall Pallof Hold
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall with your feet about hip-width apart.
Join your hands and extend your arms in front at chest height.
Set the joined hands against the wall so you can press sideways into it.
Brace your abdomen and keep your shoulders and hips facing forward.
Press your hands into the wall and hold without moving your torso, breathing steadily.
Release the pressure and repeat with the other side toward the wall.

name: Sandbag Bear Hug Carry
instructions: Place a sandbag on the floor and choose a clear walking path. Use a bag weight that lets you keep your posture controlled throughout the carry.
Stand close to the sandbag with your feet about hip-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back neutral.
Wrap both arms around the sandbag and pull it tightly against your chest and upper abdomen. Keep the bag close to your body.
Drive through your feet to stand up, using your legs and hips. Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and avoid rounding your lower back.
Walk forward with short, controlled steps. Keep the sandbag hugged firmly to your torso, shoulders down, and eyes looking ahead.
Breathe steadily and maintain a strong upright position. If the bag starts to slip or your posture breaks down, stop and reset.
At the end of the distance, squat down with the bag held close and place it on the floor under control. Do not drop it unless your training area and equipment allow it.
